findings.title: Date-override path bypasses busy/booking check
findings.body: When dateOverrideExist is true and the slot is inside the override, checkIfIsAvailable returns true immediately at lines 133-135 without reaching the busy.every() check at line 153. Therefore a fixed or round-robin host who has a Cal booking or external-calendar busy event overlapping a date-override slot will still be reported available for that slot, allowing double-bookings on override days.

findings.title: Empty (unavailable-day) override comparison is always false
findings.body: dayjs(date.start).add(...) === dayjs(date.end).add(...) compares two distinct Dayjs objects by reference, so it is always false. The intended detection of a zero-length override (the representation of a day marked unavailable) never fires; a slot straddling that instant then finds no exclusion, sets dateOverrideExist, and is returned as available instead of unavailable.

findings.title: Slot starting exactly at override end is treated as inside override
findings.body: The exclusion for slots after the override uses slotStartTime.isAfter(overrideEnd) only. A slot starting exactly at overrideEnd is not after it, its slotEnd is also not before/equal overrideStart, so find() returns falsy, dateOverrideExist remains true, and the slot is returned available even though it starts at the moment the override window closes. It should be isSameOrAfter the end.

findings.title: Working-hours check breaks split hours and never checks slot end
findings.body: Lines 140-146 set both start and end to the slot-start minutes, so a slot starting inside working hours but ending after endTime (eventLength beyond the window) is accepted. Also, find() returns true if ANY workingHour entry for that weekday excludes the slot: with split hours such as 09:00-12:00 and 13:00-17:00, a 10:00 slot matches the second entry (10:00 < 13:00) and is rejected. Since getSlots already aggregates availability, this new second filter will incorrectly remove valid slots for users with multiple intervals on a day and keep slots that overrun the window.

findings.title: Override conversion fails/wraps when shifted time crosses midnight
findings.body: Lines 218-223 reduce the shifted override start/end to hour*60+minute within a single invitee day. If applying inviteeUtcOffset-organizerUtcOffset pushes the override end past midnight (or start before midnight), endTime becomes smaller than startTime or belongs to the adjacent day; buildSlots skips start>=end ranges and drops/ truncates those slots. This reintroduces the timezone bug for overrides near day boundaries in far-apart timezones, the exact scenario the PR claims to fix.

findings.title: No test for fixed-host date override in round-robin events
findings.body: The PR description says the primary fix is that a fixed host's date override restricts round-robin availability, but the only added test (lines 788-804) repeats the existing single-user date-override scenario in Asia/Dhaka timezone. There is no round-robin/collective scenario with a fixed host having an override and a loose host available, so the new checkIfIsAvailable fixed/loose-host filtering added in slots.ts is untested and regressions would not be caught.
